lines.en: label naospecial2:
scene sky
There are pros and cons to spending my free time with a small child.
lines.zh: 用一个小孩消磨我的闲暇,有利也有弊。

lines.en: Well, this small child.
lines.zh: 好吧,是这个小孩。

lines.en: I specify this because there aren’t many pros when it comes to hanging out with small children like Chinami, and yet I keep doing that for reasons beyond my comprehension.
lines.zh: 我特别指明,是因为和 Chinami 这种小孩厮混实在没什么利可言,而我却一直在这么做,理由连我自己都无法理解。

lines.en: But Nao is obviously different.
lines.zh: 但 Nao 显然不同。

lines.en: Her inability to speak offers up the rarest form of peace and quiet in that my loneliness is temporarily quelled by her presence, but there is no need to fill the silence with anything other than the sounds of our breathing.
lines.zh: 她的无法言语,提供了一种最稀有的安宁——她的存在暂时镇压了我的孤独,而我无需用呼吸声以外的任何东西去填补寂静。

lines.en: That would be one of the pros.
lines.zh: 这算是利之一。

lines.en: The biggest con is that I must accept that even the presence of someone like her is enough to quell my loneliness in the first place- whether it be temporary or not.
lines.zh: 而最大的弊是,我必须接受:连她这样一个人的存在,都足以在最初镇压我的孤独——无论那是否只是暂时的。

lines.en: The fact remains that my existence only exists to begin with because it is tethered to any girl unfortunate enough to lock eyes with me.
lines.zh: 事实依旧:我的存在之所以存在,是因为它拴在任何一个不幸与我四目相对的女孩身上。

lines.en: On the ride to the mall, I habitually tell myself that nothing will happen.
lines.zh: 去商场的路上,我习惯性地告诉自己,什么都不会发生。

lines.en: But another voice that chases the back of our bus incessantly screams the most disgusting of reminders at me the whole way there.
lines.zh: 但另一个声音一路追逐着我们巴士的车尾,不停朝我尖叫着最恶心的提醒。

lines.en: No one would ever know.
lines.zh: 没有人会知道。

lines.en: scene naomall1

We manage to make it to the mall without anyone assuming I’m a kidnapper...and Nao is expectedly shocked to see somewhere as bright and busy as this for what I can only imagine is the first time in her life.
lines.zh: 我们总算抵达商场,没让任何人以为我是绑匪……而 Nao 毫无意外地震惊了——能亲眼看见这么明亮、这么热闹的地方,多半是她此生头一遭。

lines.en: Though, I haven’t ruled out the possibility that this “life” of hers is just getting started, so that might not be all that impressive at the end of the day.
lines.zh: 不过,我还没排除她这份「人生」才刚开头的可能,所以归根结底,这也许没那么了不起。

lines.en: Either way, here we are.
lines.zh: 不管怎样,我们到了。

lines.en: Now, I just have to figure out what I’m supposed to do when it comes to buying her clothes.
lines.zh: 现在,我只剩一件事要弄明白:给她买衣服时,我到底该怎么办。

lines.en: Logic would dictate that I take her to a clothing store because that is where clothes are located — but I have no idea what she would want to wear and I’m not about to try my hand at becoming a fashion-designer.
lines.zh: 按理说,我该带她去服装店,因为衣服就在那里——但我完全不知道她想穿什么,也不打算试着转行当服装设计师。

lines.en: Thankfully, I know someone who likely will.
lines.zh: 所幸,我认识一个大概会那么干的人。

lines.en: Unthankfully, I have no idea how I’m going to explain this to her.
lines.zh: 不幸的是,我完全不知道该怎么向她解释这件事。

lines.en: : Nao, I know you might be excited to visit the mall for the first time, but-
lines.zh: : Nao,我知道第一次来商场你可能很兴奋,但是——

lines.en: scene naomall2
: Aaaaand she’s off.
lines.zh: : 然————而她跑没影了。

lines.en: : I should have seen that coming.
lines.zh: : 我早该料到的。

lines.en: scene naomall3
: Oh, good. You came back.
lines.zh: : 哦,好。你回来了。

lines.en: : I have no idea how I’m supposed to talk to you. Where’s your notebook?
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道该怎么和你交流。你的笔记本呢?

lines.en: : You left it on the bus, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你把它落在巴士上了,对吧?

lines.en: scene naomall4
: Hah...
: Follow me. I know somewhere we can get you more...body-fabric or whatever it was.
lines.zh: : 跟我来。我知道有个地方,能给你弄到更多……身体布料,或者随便那叫什么。

lines.en: : But you’re going to have to be on your best behavior because there’s a girl who works there that I may or may not be dating. It’s complicated. Just don’t do anything that will get me in trouble.
lines.zh: : 但你得拿出最好的举止,因为那里有个打工的女孩,我或许、或许没有在和她交往。很复杂。总之别干任何会给我惹麻烦的事。

lines.en: : I’m glad you agree.
lines.zh: : 很高兴你同意。

lines.en: scene black
: Now, come on. It’s not far from here.
lines.zh: : 来吧。离这儿不远。

lines.en: scene naomall5
: Hey, great timing! I had a question about something for the Dorm Wars and I was just about to text you.
lines.zh: : 嘿,来得正好!我有个宿舍大战的问题要问,正准备给你发短信呢。

lines.en: : Well, that sucks for you because you’re about to have several more pressing questions and completely forget what you originally wanted to ask me.
lines.zh: : 嗯,那可轮不到你了,因为你马上就会有好几个更要紧的问题,并且彻底忘记你原本想问什么。

lines.en: scene naomall6
: What? Why do you say-
lines.zh: : 什么?你为什么——

lines.en: scene naomall7
scene naomall8
: Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei。

lines.en: : Hit me. I mentally prepared myself for every question you could possibly ask me on the way over here.
lines.zh: : 问吧。来这一路上,我已经为每一个你可能会问的问题做好了心理准备。

lines.en: : Have you been keeping this little girl locked in your closet the whole time you’ve known me because you were afraid I’d get jealous of how cute she is?
lines.zh: : 在认识我的这段时间里,你一直把这个小女孩锁在你的壁橱里,是因为怕我嫉妒她太可爱吗?

lines.en: : I was apparently not mentally prepared for every question you could possibly ask. But also, no. She’s a stray. Let’s just leave it at that.
lines.zh: : 显然,我并没有为每一个你可能问的问题做好心理准备。另外,不是。她是个流浪儿。我们就说到这里吧。

lines.en: : Oh, also, I need to buy clothes for her. Preferably at a discounted rate since we’re seeing each other and this place is too pricey for me.
lines.zh: : 哦,还有,我得给她买衣服。最好打折——毕竟我们在交往,而这家店对我来说太贵了。

lines.en: : Is she like...a relative of yours or something?
lines.zh: : 她是……你的什么亲戚之类的?

lines.en: : Sure, let’s go with that. That’s way easier than anything I’ve thought of and believable.
lines.zh: : 行,就这么说。这比我想过的任何说辞都省事,而且可信。

lines.en: scene naomall9
: Arf!
scene naomall10
scene naomall11
scene naomall12
: Another girl Chinami’s age! And with funny eyes!
lines.zh: : 又一个和 Chinami 同龄的女孩!还长着有趣的眼睛!

lines.en: : They’re not funny, Chinami. Be nice. This is Sensei’s...relative.
lines.zh: : 那不叫有趣,Chinami。要有礼貌。这是 Sensei 的……亲戚。

lines.en: : Hopefully.
lines.zh: : 但愿是。

lines.en: scene naomall13
: Don’t worry, Papa’s relative! Chinami isn’t a real dog! Chinami just needs to wear the dog helmet when she goes to the mall so she doesn’t get sick. You are in good paws! Arf!
lines.zh: : 别担心,Papa 的亲戚!Chinami 不是真的狗!Chinami 只是来商场时需要戴上狗狗头盔,这样才不会生病。你被好爪子照顾着!汪!

lines.en: : I think this is the first time she’s ever seen another girl her size. She’s probably just surprised she’s not the smallest person in existence.
lines.zh: : 我想,这是她头一回见到另一个和她一样个头的女孩。她大概只是惊讶于自己不再是世上最小的人。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure the giant furry helmet has nothing to do with it.
lines.zh: : 是啊,我相信那个巨大的毛绒头盔绝对与此无关。

lines.en: : What is your name, Papa’s relative? Chinami’s name is Chinami.
lines.zh: : 你叫什么名字,Papa 的亲戚?Chinami 的名字是 Chinami。

lines.en: : She’s mute, Chinami. That means she can’t-
lines.zh: : 她不会说话,Chinami。也就是说她不能——

lines.en: : Nao-chan? That’s a very pretty name!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱?那是个非常好听的名字!

lines.en: : What? How did-
lines.zh: : 什么?你怎么——

lines.en: : Nao-chan, do you have a favorite animal? Chinami’s company, Chinami-Corp, is the leading distributor of animals in all of Kumon-mi!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱,你有最喜欢的动物吗?Chinami 的公司,Chinami-Corp,是全 Kumon-mi 最大的动物经销商!

lines.en: : We started as a giraffe company, but have now expanded to all sorts of safari animals! If you need it, Chinami’s got it! That’s the Chinami-Corp slogan.
lines.zh: : 我们从长颈鹿公司起家,如今已扩展到各种 Safari 动物!你要什么,Chinami 就有什么!这就是 Chinami-Corp 的口号。

lines.en: : Chinami’s friend Tsukasa came up with it. Tsukasa has lots of money and invited Chinami to live in her mansion! Cool, right?
lines.zh: : 这是 Chinami 的朋友 Tsukasa 想的。Tsukasa 有很多很多钱,还邀请 Chinami 住进她的豪宅!酷吧?

lines.en: scene naomall14
: Really? Chinami’s never met anyone who likes rhinos so much before! You’re in luck, Nao-chan! Chinami-Corp just got a brand new shipment!
lines.zh: : 真的吗?Chinami 从没见过这么喜欢犀牛的人!你运气真好,Nao 酱!Chinami-Corp 刚到一批全新的货!

lines.en: scene naomall15
: How...is she understanding her?
lines.zh: : 她……怎么听懂她的?

lines.en: : She’s probably just making things up. She’s a kid, they do that. And it’s something you should know if you’re going to be adopting our first daughter behind my back.
lines.zh: : 她多半只是在瞎编。她是小孩,小孩都这样。而你若打算背着我领养我们的大女儿,这是你该知道的事。

lines.en: : She’s not our daughter, Chika.
lines.zh: : 她不是我们的女儿,Chika。

lines.en: : Good, because Chinami already kind of is and I don’t make enough money to be a mother of two. Plus, I’d feel weird asking you to be my sugar daddy at this stage in our relationship.
lines.zh: : 那就好,因为 Chinami 已经差不多算是了,而我的钱不够当两个孩子的妈。再说,在我们关系的这个阶段,让你当我的糖爹,我会觉得怪怪的。

lines.en: : Nao-chan, what else do you like? Chinami wants to know about your hobbies!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱,你还喜欢什么?Chinami 想知道你的爱好!

lines.en: scene naomall14
: You like reading manga? And you’re here today because all you have is a hoodie and your mommy wants you to buy more clothes?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢看漫画?你今天来这里,是因为你只有一件连帽衫,而你妈妈想让你多买几件衣服?

lines.en: : See? That. That’s exactly why we’re here. And she even knows her name. How?
lines.zh: : 看到没?就是这个。这正是我们来这儿的原因。而且她连她的名字都知道。怎么做到的?

lines.en: : Why are you looking at me? It’s not like I know everything about kids just because I take care of one.
lines.zh: : 你看我干嘛?又不是说我带了一个孩子,就对小孩无所不知了。

lines.en: : They’re probably just doing that thing kids do where they connect brainwaves and communicate without having to speak.
lines.zh: : 她们大概只是在干小孩都会的那件事——连接脑电波,不用开口就能交流。

lines.en: : They're doing what?
lines.zh: : 她们在干什么?

lines.en: : The thing I just said. You've seriously never realized how kids can just communicate like that?
lines.zh: : 我刚说的那件事。你真从来没意识到,小孩是可以那样直接交流的?

lines.en: : No...I’ve never even heard of that before.
lines.zh: : 没有……我连听都没听说过。

lines.en: : Well, you probably weren’t very popular when you were younger then.
lines.zh: : 那么,你小时候多半不太受欢迎。

lines.en: : Chinami, do you want to-
lines.zh: : Chinami,你要不要——

lines.en: scene naomall16
: Oh, okay. See that? I was about to ask her to go help Nao-chan pick out clothes and they’re already ahead of me.
lines.zh: : 哦,好。看见没?我刚要请她去帮 Nao 酱挑衣服,结果她们已经领先我一截了。

lines.en: scene naomall17
: Chika, can I just leave her here? I have no idea what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : Chika,我能把她留在这儿吗?我完全不知道自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Are you crazy? Absolutely not. I’m not even supposed to be bringing Chinami to work.
lines.zh: : 你疯了吗?绝对不行。我按规定都不该带 Chinami 来上班。

lines.en: : If I turn the store into a giant daycare center, I’ll lose my job quicker than Kirin loses her top during the dorm’s weekly game night.
lines.zh: : 要是我把这家店变成巨型托儿所,我丢工作的速度,会比 Kirin 在宿舍每周游戏之夜上掉上衣的速度还快。

lines.en: : The...dorm has a weekly game night?
lines.zh: : 宿舍……有每周游戏之夜?

lines.en: scene naomall18
: You really didn’t know? We’ve been doing it since all of the Kumon-mi Academy girls transferred in.
lines.zh: : 你真不知道?自从 Kumon-mi 学园的女孩们转过来之后,我们就一直在搞了。

lines.en: : What? How have I not encountered this at any point?
lines.zh: : 什么?我怎么从来没有遇到过?

lines.en: scene naomall19

: Because I’m just messing around with you, doofus. You really think I’d spend my free time with Kirin? I just wanted to seize a good opportunity to smack talk her since she’s always trying to flirt with you.
lines.zh: : 因为我在逗你玩呢,笨蛋。你真觉得我会把空闲时间花在 Kirin 身上?我只是想抓住一个好机会说她坏话,谁让她总想跟你调情。

lines.en: : I feel so betrayed. The only way to make this up to me is by taking Nao off my hands so I can wander around and do adult things.
lines.zh: : 我感觉被背叛了。补偿我的唯一方式,就是把 Nao 从我手里接走,好让我四处逛逛、干点成年人的事。

lines.en: scene naomall20
: Come over tonight and I’ll let you do as many adult things as you want.
lines.zh: : 今晚过来,你想干多少成年人的事,我就让你干多少。

lines.en: : Just maybe don’t bring the kid. I’m pretty open in regard to the whole threesome thing, but even I’ve got my limits, you know?
lines.zh: : 只是,或许别把孩子带来。三人行这种事我相当开放,但连我也有底线,知道吗?

lines.en: : First off, don’t tempt me with a good time.
lines.zh: : 首先,别拿好时光诱惑我。

lines.en: : Second, what does it even matter if you put your job in danger? I thought you were quitting this place to go work at the maid cafe?
lines.zh: : 其次,你把工作置于险境又有什么要紧?你不是要辞了这里去女仆咖啡厅吗?

lines.en: scene naomall21
: Uhh...after the tour thing Uta took me on, I kind of got the feeling I’m not really wanted there.
lines.zh: : 呃……经过 Uta 带我参观那次,我隐隐感觉那里其实不欢迎我。

lines.en: : That’s just Ami being Ami. I’m sure she’d settle down once you joined the staff.
lines.zh: : 那只是 Ami 的本色出演。等你加入店员行列,她自会安分下来。

lines.en: : Maybe. But I kind of have to be a little careful when it comes to stepping on Ami’s toes so she doesn’t completely hate me once you and I don’t have to hide our relationship anymore.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但在踩 Ami 脚尖这件事上,我得稍微小心——免得等你我再也不必隐瞒关系时,她把我恨到骨头里。

lines.en: : Teenage girls are ruthless, Sensei. One wrong move and that girl might chop my head off.
lines.zh: : 十几岁的女孩可是冷酷无情的,Sensei。一步走错,那丫头可能砍掉我的脑袋。

lines.en: scene naomall22

: If you’re really worried about what you’re supposed to do with her, just treat her like Chinami. You watch her all the time and she loves you. I’m sure Nao-chan will be the same way with a little more time.
lines.zh: : 你要是真担心该拿她怎么办,就把她当 Chinami 对待。你一直看着她,而她爱你。我相信再多给点时间,Nao 酱也会一样。

lines.en: : Nao is way different from Chinami.
lines.zh: : Nao 和 Chinami 差得远。

lines.en: : How? They’re the same age, aren’t they? If they weren’t, their brainwaves wouldn’t be connecting like they clearly are.
lines.zh: : 怎么不同?她们同龄,不是吗?要不是,她们的脑电波就不会像现在这样明明连通着。

lines.en: : Nao is just...complicated, okay? And it doesn’t help that her mother is literally insane.
lines.zh: : Nao 只是……很复杂,行吗?何况她妈妈字面意义上是疯的,这可没帮上忙。

lines.en: scene naomall23
: It didn’t help that my mom died and I turned out okay, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我妈妈死了也没帮上什么忙,而我最后不还是长得好好的,不是吗?

lines.en: : Granted, I was a little older than she is when that happened, but still.
lines.zh: : 诚然,那件事发生时我比她大一点,但仍然。

lines.en: : Just be yourself and everything will be fine. It’s not like she’s yours forever, right?
lines.zh: : 做你自己就好,一切都会没事。她又不永远属于你,对吧?

lines.en: : Also, who is her mom and why are you keeping so many important figures in your life away from me when you should be subtly introducing me to them without revealing that I’m your little cum dumpster?
lines.zh: : 还有,她妈妈是谁?你为什么把生命里这么多重要人物都藏着不让我见——你本该在不暴露「我是你的小精液垃圾桶」的前提下,不着痕迹地引荐我认识他们?

lines.en: : Why are you being so hot today?
lines.zh: : 你今天怎么这么辣?

lines.en: scene naomall24
: God, I don’t know! I’ve been like this since I woke up and it’s driving me crazy. I just want to fuck my boyfriend and all I keep hearing is-
lines.zh: : 天,我不知道!打从醒来到现在一直这样,快把我逼疯了。我只想上我男朋友,结果耳边一直是——

lines.en: : Big sis Chika!
lines.zh: : Chika 大姐!

lines.en: : That. That’s what I keep hearing.
lines.zh: : 就是这个。我耳边一直是这个。

lines.en: scene black
: What, Chinami? Do you need something?
lines.zh: : 怎么了,Chinami?有事吗?

lines.en: : Yes! Chinami needs big sis Chika and Papa to come to the dressing room so we can unveil Nao-chan’s new look!
lines.zh: : 有!Chinami 需要 Chika 大姐和 Papa 来试衣间,这样我们就能揭开 Nao 酱的新造型!

lines.en: : Chinami tried to help her choose clothes, but Nao-chan found things she liked all by herself and Chinami was useless! Sad day!
lines.zh: : Chinami 本想帮她挑衣服,可 Nao 酱自己就找到了喜欢的东西,Chinami 毫无用处!伤心的一天!

lines.en: : Also, it’s Nao-chan’s first time ever choosing her own outfit, so nobody laugh! Got it? Even if it’s bad! Which it’s not because Nao-chan did a great job!
lines.zh: : 还有,这是 Nao 酱人生第一次自己选整套衣服,所以谁都不许笑!明白吗?哪怕很糟也不许!而它不糟,因为 Nao 酱干得非常棒!

lines.en: : Will you be paying cash or credit, sir?
lines.zh: : 先生,您付现金还是刷卡?

lines.en: : Is there an alternate way I could pay?
lines.zh: : 有没有别的付款方式?

lines.en: : God, don’t do this to me today.
lines.zh: : 天,今天别这么对我。

lines.en: : Ladies and gentlemen! Chinami-Corp introduces...
lines.zh: : 女士们先生们!Chinami-Corp 荣誉推出……

lines.en: scene naomall25
: Nao-chan 2.0!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱 2.0!

lines.en: : Nao-chan is wearing a brand new shirt from our new “shirt” line! The color is blue, which is also the color of the ocean! And the ocean is where fish are!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱穿着我们全新「衬衫」系列的崭新衬衫!颜色是蓝色,也就是大海的颜色!而大海里住着鱼!

lines.en: scene naomall26
: Nao-chan is also wearing a blue skirt, a blue belt, and blue shoes! And since Chinami is good when it comes to context clues, she’s deduced that Nao-chan’s favorite color is probably blue as well!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱还穿了蓝裙子、蓝腰带和蓝鞋!而由于 Chinami 擅长上下文推断,她已经推定:Nao 酱最喜欢的颜色八成也是蓝色!

lines.en: scene naomall27
scene naomall28
scene naomall29
: Well, her modeling poses definitely need a little work. And I’m no fashion designer, but I think a little less blue might be good as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯,她的模特姿势肯定还需要练习。我不是服装设计师,但我觉得蓝色少一点或许也好。

lines.en: : What do you think, Chika? You’re good at this kind of stuff r-
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢,Chika?你擅长这种事——

lines.en: scene naomall30
: KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!!!!!

lines.en: : OH...MY...GOD! SHE IS ADORABLE!!!
lines.zh: : 我……的……天!她太可爱了!!!

lines.en: : THE LITTLE POSES! THE WAY HER OUTFIT IS LIKE, TOTALLY HORRIBLE BUT IN A WAY THAT’S MEGA CUTE SINCE YOU KNOW SHE’S TRYING HER BEST!
lines.zh: : 那些小姿势!还有那身穿搭,简直,完全灾难,却又灾难得超级可爱,因为你知道她已经在拼尽全力了!

lines.en: : I NEED HER! LET ME HAVE HER! I WANT TO DRESS HER UP IN EVERYTHING WE HAVE!
lines.zh: : 我要她!把她给我!我想用店里所有的衣服把她从头到脚穿个遍!

lines.en: : Did you hear that, Nao-chan? Big sis Chika loves your outfit! You did a really great job!
lines.zh: : 听见了吗,Nao 酱?Chika 大姐超爱你的穿搭!你干得非常非常棒!

lines.en: scene naomall31
: Heheh...hehehehe...you’re mine now, Nao-chan...I’ve always wanted a doll...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……嘿嘿嘿嘿……你现在是我的了,Nao 酱……我一直都想要一个娃娃……

lines.en: : Doing okay over there?
lines.zh: : 那边还好吗?

lines.en: scene naomall32
: So, umm...
lines.zh: : 那么,呃……

lines.en: : Remember earlier when I said it was good that Nao-chan wasn’t our daughter since I can’t afford being a mother of two?
lines.zh: : 还记得我刚才说,Nao 酱不是我们的女儿真好,因为我养不起两个孩子吗?

lines.en: : Is it too late to maybe...change my mind about that?
lines.zh: : 现在,要……改变主意,会不会太晚了?

lines.en: scene naomall33
: Pweeeeeeeease, Daddy? I’ll do anything you want...
lines.zh: : 求求你了嘛,Daddy?你要我做什么都行……

lines.en: scene naomall34
: Stop just looking at me. You’re making me feel weird.
lines.zh: : 别光盯着我看。你让我感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: scene black
scene naomall35
Ignoring the fact that Chika hasn’t taken her eyes off of Nao since the moment she stepped out of the dressing room, I think things went pretty well.
lines.zh: 撇开 Chika 自打 Nao 走出试衣间那一刻起就再没移开视线这一点,我认为事情进行得相当顺利。

lines.en: Nao is clearly proud of herself, Chinami made a new friend, and her clothes were extremely cheap.
lines.zh: Nao 显然为自己骄傲,Chinami 交了新朋友,而且衣服极其便宜。

lines.en: So cheap, in fact, that I didn’t even have to pay for them since the only girl working here at the moment is currently caught in a daze and potentially on the brink of becoming a kidnapper.
lines.zh: 便宜到什么程度呢——我甚至不用付钱,因为此刻店里唯一在岗的女孩正陷于恍惚,随时可能成为一名绑匪。

lines.en: In fact, I kind of wish she would so I wouldn’t have to spend any more time-
lines.zh: 实际上,我倒有点希望她那么干,这样我就不用再花时间——

lines.en: scene naomall36
God damn it...I’m starting to like her.
lines.zh: 该死……我开始喜欢她了。

lines.en: : Do you like your new outfit, Nao?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢你的新衣服吗,Nao?

lines.en: scene naomall37
: Chinami likes it too!
lines.zh: : Chinami 也喜欢!

lines.en: : But she’s really sad she doesn’t know when she’ll see Nao-chan again...
lines.zh: : 但她很难过,因为不知道什么时候才能再见到 Nao 酱……

lines.en: scene naomall38
: Really?! Chinami is very excited! She has doubled her friend count in one day! Chinami-Corp is growing!
lines.zh: : 真的吗?!Chinami 非常兴奋!她的朋友数量一天翻倍!Chinami-Corp 正在壮大!

lines.en: : Business-oriented as ever, I see.
lines.zh: : 果然一如既往地商业头脑在线。

lines.en: scene naomall39
: It’s just like Bill Gates always says...“Hi! I’m Bill Gates!”
lines.zh: : 就像 Bill Gates 总说的……「嗨!我是 Bill Gates!」

lines.en: : Well said, Chinami. Now, say goodbye to Nao. Our mission for the day is complete.
lines.zh: : 说得好,Chinami。现在,和 Nao 说再见。我们今天的任务完成了。

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to stick around for the rest of the day? Maybe longer? Or maybe we could all just go live together and start a big family somewhere in the mountains?
lines.zh: : 你确定今天剩下的时间不想留下来?或者更久?或者干脆我们所有人一起搬去山里同居,组建一个大家庭?

lines.en: : Nope. Now that the hard part is over, I’m going to take Nao back to her rightful-ish mother and forget this day ever happened.
lines.zh: : 不。既然最难的部分已经过去,我要把 Nao 带回她名义上的母亲身边,然后忘掉今天发生过的一切。

lines.en: : I’ll remember this day for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 这一天,我会铭记终生。

lines.en: : How do you like her this much after one meeting?
lines.zh: : 见了一面,你怎么就能喜欢成这样?

lines.en: scene naomall40
: Are you blind? Can you see this creature?
lines.zh: : 你瞎了吗?你看见这个生物了吗?

lines.en: : You were totally normal when she walked in.
lines.zh: : 她刚走进来的时候,你还完全正常来着。

lines.en: : Yeah, and then stuff happened. Now, I would kill for her.
lines.zh: : 是啊,然后事情就发生了。现在,我可以为她杀人。

lines.en: : Well, that won’t be happening. Come on, Nao. We’re going home.
lines.zh: : 嗯,那种事不会发生。走吧,Nao。我们回家。

lines.en: scene naomall41
scene naomall42
scene naomall43
: Bye-bye, Papa! Bring Nao-chan over to visit one day! Preferably somewhere Chinami doesn’t have to wear her dog helmet!
lines.zh: : 拜拜,Papa!哪天带 Nao 酱来玩!最好是 Chinami 不用戴狗狗头盔的地方!

lines.en: : Will do. And to Chika...I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 一定。还有,对 Chika……我很抱歉。

lines.en: : Oh, crap.
lines.zh: : 哦,糟了。

lines.en: : ...Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : ……大事不妙。

lines.en: : This is, like...totally not good.
lines.zh: : 这,那个……完全不妙。

lines.en: : ...Do I even want to ask?
lines.zh: : ……我想问吗?

lines.en: : I think I’m about to get baby fever.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我快要得宝宝热了。

lines.en: : And I think I’m about to avoid you until it blows over. See you later, you two.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得,在它过去之前,我要躲着你。回见,你们俩。

lines.en: scene black
: Wait, Papa! Come back! Chinami wants a little sister and this might be the best chance we get!
lines.zh: : 等等,Papa!回来!Chinami 想要一个妹妹,这可能是我们最好的机会!

lines.en: : I agree with Nao.
lines.zh: : 我同意 Nao。

lines.en: : Then why are you walking away?!?!
lines.zh: : 那你为什么要走开?!?!

lines.en: scene noonsky
Nao and I leave the mall and...
lines.zh: Nao 和我离开商场,然后……

lines.en: Honestly?
lines.zh: 说实话?

lines.en: I’m feeling pretty good.
lines.zh: 我感觉相当不错。

lines.en: It’s been weirdly entertaining getting to hang out with her and...I think she’s finally managing to win me over.
lines.zh: 和她厮混的这段时光,有着一种说不出的有趣……我想,她终于快把我拿下了。

lines.en: Like, sure...there’s the issue of her existence being extremely questionable in nature. But I see no harm in just...letting things play out normally for now, right?
lines.zh: 就是说,当然……她的存在本质极其可疑,这是个问题。但眼下只是……让事情顺其自然地发展,我看不出有什么坏处,对吧?

lines.en: $ naospecial2 = True
$ nao_love += 1
jump naospecial3
